description: Functions and classes for working with Itasca clump cfd.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Get the number of CFD clumps.

functions.name: find
functions.description: Get the CFD clump object with the given ID number.

functions.name: inbox
functions.signature: itasca.clump.cfd.inbox(lower_bound: vec, upper_bound: vec, intersect=True) -> Tuple of CFD clump objects
functions.description: Get a tuple of CFD clumps with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the CFD clump. The if the optional keyword argument intersect is False then only CFD clumps with positions falling in the box are returned.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Get a CFD clump iterator object.

functions.name: maxid
functions.description: Get the maximum CFD clump ID.

functions.name: near
functions.signature: itasca.clump.cfd.near(point: vec, radius=0.0) -> CFD clump object
functions.description: Find the closest CFD clump to a point. If the optional keyword argument radius is non-zero, only search within this radius.
